verdict.rationale: Quo, a business phone SaaS (not itself an agent), documents a public, official MCP server on its support site. The server lets any agent manage conversations, contacts, call history, voicemail transcripts and texting in plain English, and a probe confirms the official MCP documentation page exists. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration of the server working, and documented connection specifics (endpoint URL, auth/setup steps) in the evidence.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can connect an agent via an official MCP server

citations.quote: plus a public MCP server and an API your own agent can read and act on
Connect Quo to any agent and manage your conversations, contacts, and call transcripts in plain English. No coding required.
Search your contact list, look up a specific contact’s details, add new contacts, or update existing ones just by asking.
